channel.title: 537: forecast movement
channel.description: What the forecast changed its mind about.

item.title: Premier League: 8 clubs moved
item.description: Manchester United's chance of qualifying for the Champions League fell from 61% to 51%. Brighton & Hove Albion's chance of qualifying for the Champions League rose from 17% to 26%.
